_comment: Hand-transcribed from the Federal Reserve's own published FOMC calendar. FRED has NO reliable API for this — its 'FOMC Press Release' release (id 101) returns a release date for every single calendar day once no-data dates are included (verified live 2026-08-27), which is not a real schedule and must never be used as one. This file is therefore the manual half of daytrade/macro_calendar.py's three-source merge. `date` is the SECOND day of each two-day meeting -- the day the statement/decision is actually released. Re-verify against source_url periodically; the Fed typically publishes a year of meetings at once and they rarely move.
